hints.title: Wide to Long Reshaping
hints.text: Converting multiple quarterly metric columns into rows turns a wide format table into a normalized long format. Which DataFrame method unpivots wide columns?

hints.title: Identifier and Value Variable Specification
hints.text: The melt method unpivots columns into identifier variables and measured variables. What parameter designates non-pivoted identifiers?

hints.title: Melt Parameterization
hints.text: Use report.melt(id_vars=['product'], var_name='quarter', value_name='sales') to transpose quarterly columns into rows with standard column labels.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: number of unpivoted quarter columns (typically 4)
complexity.notes: Linear reshaping replicating identifiers across unpivoted column dimensions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual iteration appending tuples produces substantial overhead compared to vectorized buffer reshaping.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating the unpivoted long format requires memory proportional to rows times unpivoted columns.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct configuration of id_vars, var_name, and value_name parameters.
